Name: Smooshed Bait
Author: Kaizlin
Description:
I got tired of all of the leftover bait laying around from my worm bins in the late-game. I decided that it would be cool if I could smoosh it back in to a piece of bug meat to be used for other stuff, like Linus' Super Bait™. It's made of the same stuff. It's gross and slimy. Makes sense that you should be able to mash it back together.

The recipe is an even conversion of 5 bait in to one meat, and should automatically appear in your crafting list after reaching fishing level 2.

This is my first ever mod. I taught myself how to make it in like an hour, and tested it for all of about 10 seconds in game. If it breaks or doesn't work, I don't know how to fix it... yet. Do let me know so that I can try to figure it out, but it's a super simple Content Patcher mod, so I don't foresee any issues. Requires the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
